related.title: 海底電力電纜工程
related.why: 共用絕緣與接頭熱電模型

related.transferEn: Insulation and joint thermal/electrical models transfer
related.difference: 海纜增加水深、張力與海床條件
related.differenceEn: Subsea adds depth, tension and seabed conditions
practice: 以「導體電阻」為起點，畫出本課與「海底電力電纜工程」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「海纜增加水深、張力與海床條件」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from conductor resistance and mark shared/redefined boundaries with subsea power-cable engineering.
For the difference "Subsea adds depth, tension and seabed conditions", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
